cues: It is a call to action: hope exists only if enough people walk it into being.
And notice the frame: the same golden moon that opened the memory now closes the story, the past turned into a dream of the future.
text: It is not a promise. It is a call to action: hope exists only if enough people walk it into being. And notice the frame: the same golden moon that opened the memory now closes the story, the past turned into a dream of the future.
